comment: Stargate users have no website, gender, birthdate, zoneinfo, locale, middle_name or profile claims; the test user also has no picture or family_name.
Stargate includes scope-granted email claims in the ID token as well as userinfo, which relying parties rely on.

The claims request parameter is not supported (claims_parameter_supported=false); userinfo only returns name with the profile scope.
The test needs the OP's signing keys rotated while it runs; Stargate rotates them by adding a key and restarting (docs/oauth-oidc-provider-guide.md), which the unattended run cannot do.
